description: Brazil company financial figures, newest period first. Brazil (CVM) data is available to paid accounts only. The data route refuses requests without a paid account's key or sign-in (403). One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

id.description: A B3 ticker (such as PETR4), a 1–6 digit CVM code or a 14-digit CNPJ (digits or printed form).
